message.content: An editorial illustration for the magazine TEMPO, dated 28 AGUSTUS-3 SEPTEMBER 2023, features a red masthead. Below it, large clouds of gray and beige smoke form three human-like hands. One hand on the left points towards a factory and a car. Another hand on the right points downward at the car. A third hand from the bottom points at a man standing on the left. The man, with a mustache and wearing a light-colored button-down shirt and dark pants, has a clenched fist. Behind a chain-link fence stands a reddish-brown factory building with a tall chimney emitting a thin trail of smoke. To the right, the rear of a white car with license plate "B 4 TUK" emits smoke from its exhaust pipe. Text in the center reads "JAKARTA SESAK NAPAS" and "Udara Jakarta dan kota di sekitarnya tak layak hirup. Kehabisan akal mencari solusi. H.22". Other text includes "Senjata Ilegal Kelompok Teror H.64" and "Kisruh Gas PGN H.74". A barcode and QR code are in the top right corner.
